Observe the measures of pots in figure 7.8 and 7.9. How many jugs of water can the cylindrical pot hold ?

(From fig. 7.8, the conical water jug has base radius 3.5 cm and depth 10 cm. From fig. 7.9, the cylindrical water pot has base radius 7 cm and height 10 cm.)

In figure 7.11, a toy made from a hemisphere, a cylinder and a cone is shown. Find the total area of the toy.

(From fig. 7.11: the hemisphere, the cylinder and the cone all have radius 3 cm; the cylindrical part is 40 cm long and the height of the cone is 4 cm.)
